[size=5][color=#ff0000]MacOS (IMPORTANT!!):[/color][/size]
 - There are compatibility issues with MacOS related to finding the audio files.
 - Do this fix after installing the mod as normal
 Fix:
﻿1. Locate your Stardew Valley folder (something like C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley on windows)
﻿  ﻿- Locate your Stardew Voices folder and copy down the name somewhere (it might be something like StardewVoices 2012389123098 etc...)
﻿2. Create a "Mods" folder in your ﻿/StardewValley/Contents/Resources/ folder.
﻿3. Create a new folder using the SAME NAME your Stardew Voices folder uses 
﻿4. Go back to the Stardew Voices folder and locate the "Audio" folder. Move this entire folder into the new Stardew Voices folder you created   ﻿  ﻿in ﻿/StardewValley/Contents/Resources/Mods

This should fix the issues! I will continue to work on a solution that does not require this workaround but for now this will have to do. Thank you for your patience!

[size=5]
Compatible with multiple languages! [/size]
*This will result in the English voice over lines being played even when the game is configured for a different language*

Instructions
Without Generic Mod Config Menu installed:
﻿1. Open the Config.json file in your Stardew Voices folder
﻿2. You will see "Language": "en" replace "en" with the EXACT string in the list below that corresponds to your language
  [i]﻿Note: You will have to restart the game for changes to take effect.[/i]

[list]
[*]Deutsch: "de"[/*]
[*]Español: "es"[/*]
[*]Français: "fr"[/*]
[*]Italiano: "it"[/*]
[*]日本語: "ja"[/*]
[*]한국인: "ko"[/*]
[*]Magyar: "hu"[/*]
[*]Português: "pt"[/*]
[*]Русский: "ru"[/*]
[*]Türkçe: "tr"[/*]
[*]中国人: "zh"[/*]
[/list]With Generic Mod Config!
- Open the generic mod config (either through keyboard shortcut or the gear icon at the bottom left of your menu screen)
- Click the dropdown at the top labeled "Language" and select your desired language
  [i]﻿Note: You will have to restart the game for changes to take effect.[/i]
- ANOTHER NOTE: The language chosen MUST match the language Stardew Valley is configured in


[color=#ff0000][size=5]New in 2.0.3[/size][/color]
• Supported for Generic Mod Config Menu: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098
•  Control volume of characters individually from within menu or config.
• Change the language Stardew Voices uses from within the config menu (YOU WILL HAVE TO RESTART YOUR GAME FOR CHANGES TO TAKE EFFECT)
• Languages with special characters supported now! (Korean, Russian, Japanese, Chinese)

[size=5]FAQ[/size]
- [i]Will you be doing the whole game?
[/i]- No, instead I will be posting a code walkthrough / tutorial so anyone can make their own version of the mod! The idea is as long as this mod is installed you can supply your own audio files and make it work for any character! 

Unfortunately, I no longer have the means to finance a project at this scale, so hiring voice actors at the rate I have been paying for this project is no longer feasible. 

- [i]What about Clint and Sandy?
[/i]-  This isn't a HARD no. I definitely want to polish what I have released first though + do all that marketing I said I was gonna do. Depending on the reception there I may do a small crowdfunding campaign.

-[i]Will you be covering mods that add dialogue in the future?
[/i][b]-[/b] No

-[i]Can I voice in it?
[/i]- I'll post to my socials if/when I do auditions for this project but will likely defer to those with voice acting experience.

-[i]Can I make content using voice lines?
[/i]-Sure! Just be sure to credit the mod and not to use any content to train AI Models.

-[i]Is any AI used?
[/i]-Not for any voices! (For recent updates I have been using AI to answer coding questions and help with translations)
